# `aitbc agent workflow create-workflow`

Create a new multi-step workflow from a steps definition file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc agent workflow create-workflow [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | text | — | yes | Workflow name |
| `--description` | text | — | no | Workflow description |
| `--steps-file` | path | — | yes | JSON file with workflow steps |
| `--coordinator-url` | text | — | no | Agent coordinator URL (default: config agent_coordinator_url) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc agent workflow create-workflow --name <name> --steps-file <steps_file>
```
